value.rationale: The natural generalized classical third-order Narayana family exhibits a sharp qualitative change from a permutation of all states for odd coefficients to a one-dimensional periodic attractor for even coefficients. The complete cycle census across all coefficients and 2-power moduli is an infinite structural classification; its two distinct valuation thresholds at c and c+2 and exact transient-cardinality law are not isolated numerical improvements.
